note: How SFUSD students get to school, from SF Safe Routes to School's biennial Travel Tally. Car shares are the 2024-25 Annual Report's (p. 41 bar chart; 48.6% from its p. 40 pie). Bike shares carry the most precise figure any report prints: 2019-20 is printed only as a whole 1% (2019-20 Evaluation Highlights; 2020-21 report; 2024-25 report p. 41); 2022-23 is 1.1% (2023-24 report, Fig. 1, p. 36); 2024-25 is 2.0% (2024-25 report, p. 40 pie). Each tally sits at the date it was taken: the 2020-21 report says the 2019-20 tally 'The last time this survey was conducted was in Fall 2019'; the 2023-24 report announced the 2024-25 tally for fall 2024; no report dates the 2022-23 tally, which sits at fall 2022, two years before the next, as the tally is biennial [inference]. Read 2026-10-07. Walk and transit are the 2024-25 report's (p. 41 bar chart; 18.1% and 26.8% from its p. 40 pie). Its transit counts Muni and the yellow school bus together (pp. 4-5).
